objective.text: Keep package service-provider boot work lightweight rather than performing network I/O during every application boot.

difficulty.rationale: Keep registration available when an optional integration is unavailable.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: A provider’s boot method calls an optional vendor API to discover settings. When the vendor is down, unrelated Artisan commands fail during application boot.

stem: Which refactor removes that unwanted boot-time dependency?

options.text: Catch the boot exception and silently persist an empty settings set as authoritative.
options.rationale: That can turn an outage into durable incorrect configuration rather than handling unavailable optional data at the operation boundary.
options.misconception: That can turn an outage into durable incorrect configuration rather than handling unavailable optional data at the operation boundary.

options.text: Increase the vendor timeout inside boot to cover longer outages.
options.rationale: That can prolong failures and does not remove the dependency from unrelated commands.
options.misconception: That can prolong failures and does not remove the dependency from unrelated commands.

options.text: Register the client during bootstrapping; fetch and cache remote settings only in operations that need them.
options.rationale: Registration can remain local while dependent operations own remote failure and freshness handling.

options.text: Move the same blocking API call from boot into register.
options.rationale: Both methods participate in application bootstrapping, so unrelated commands still depend on the vendor.
options.misconception: Both methods participate in application bootstrapping, so unrelated commands still depend on the vendor.
